translations.web: I have sewed sackcloth on my skin, and have thrust my horn in the dust.
translations.bsb: I have sewn sackcloth over my skin; I have buried my horn in the dust.
translations.kjv: I have sewed sackcloth upon my skin, and defiled my horn in the dust.
translations.asv: I have sewed sackcloth upon my skin, And have laid my horn in the dust.
